Candidate content uses candidate_set / candidate_registry_fixture.

NOTE: check_cases.py rglob-scans owned files through scan_bytes, which strict-decodes UTF-8; a __pycache__/*.pyc in frozen-cases fails the check. It also forbids expected_stale_concept_ids outside the stale-source category, so a mixed covered+stale frozen case cannot be added without a checker change; coverage exercises that mix in partial-stale.json.
